plg_content_fgautolightbox.name: FG AutoLightbox
plg_content_fgautolightbox.description: Automatically turns article images into a responsive, accessible lightbox without changing the editor workflow.

pkg_fgbackendlangswitcher.name: FG Backend LangSwitcher
pkg_fgbackendlangswitcher.description: Lets each Joomla administrator switch the backend language for their own session without changing the site's global language.

plg_system_fgadminlogincustom.name: FG Admin Login Customizer
plg_system_fgadminlogincustom.description: Customize the Joomla administrator login screen with your own branding, colours, background and front-end styling.

plg_system_fgofflineipwhitelist.name: FG Offline IP Whitelist
plg_system_fgofflineipwhitelist.description: Allow trusted IP addresses or networks to access a Joomla site while the public frontend is in Offline mode.

plg_system_fgemailremover.name: FG Email Remover
plg_system_fgemailremover.description: Removes email addresses from public HTML output so literal addresses do not reach automated spam harvesters.

plg_fgeditorswitcher.name: FG Editor Switcher
plg_fgeditorswitcher.description: Switch between installed Joomla editors directly from the edit screen while preserving unsaved content and your preferred editor choice.

plg_system_fgremovegenerator.name: FG Remove Generator
plg_system_fgremovegenerator.description: Removes Joomla generator metadata and optional fingerprinting HTTP response headers to reduce passive CMS and platform identification.

plg_system_fgstripcomments.name: FG Strip Comments
plg_system_fgstripcomments.description: Adds private markers to Joomla content that remain visible to administrators but are removed from the public frontend.
